_what: HANDOFF 164 / QUEUE R5+R6. The pinch GAIN, measured on unmodified shipping code with a VERIFIED reset. Companion to _pinch.json, whose magnitudes are not quotable (see _caveat below).
driver: CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent, 2 fingers, 12 steps, horizontal, centre (196,420)
flags: ?intro=0&drift=0, cancelGraphicsAutoDetect() first, waited for austin-entrances LOADED
verdict: PINCH CLOSED CLIMBS, PINCH OPEN DESCENDS = the universal map convention (closed = zoom out = away from the ground = up). NOT inverted. js/controls.js unchanged.

gain._why_this_site: roofAt(r=1m)=0 AND roofAt(r=R_CAM 6m)=0, so the collision hard net provably cannot fire and the gesture is measured alone
gain._reset: verified in a loop: re-jump until !driving AND |altUser-target|<0.5 AND |alt-target|<0.5, else the reading is discarded
gain._finding: 4.333x against an ideal of 4.333x, twice, to three decimals. The gesture is a pure log-proportional map of the finger gap: altUser *= (gapBefore/gapAfter). It is NOT over-sensitive - that was R5's open question and this closes it. The OPEN ratios fall short of the ideal because the fast descent drops move events on a loaded page; direction is the claim, not the exact metre.

R6_the_amplifier_is_not_the_gesture._claim: The pinch applies sum(L)=1.4663 -> 4.33x at EVERY site. Where the eye ends higher, the collision hard net moved it, not the finger.
R6_the_amplifier_is_not_the_gesture._hard_net: js/controls.js: rCam() = lerp(R_CAM_GROUND 1m, R_CAM 6m, groundMix()); groundMix -> 0 at ALT_GROUND 12m; then `if (h > 0 && alt < h + HARD_CLEAR) { alt = altUser = h + HARD_CLEAR; }`

R6_the_amplifier_is_not_the_gesture._status: NOT FIXED, deliberately. It is a safety guarantee (never inside a building) and one-way. Recorded as QUEUE R6.
R6_the_amplifier_is_not_the_gesture._read_not_driven: That Q and the wheel behave identically follows from the net sitting in the tick downstream of where vertKey, wheelLogAcc and touchLogAcc all fold into one L - but ONLY THE PINCH WAS DRIVEN. Drive Q before quoting it.
R6_the_amplifier_is_not_the_gesture._not_a_contradiction_with_collision_mjs: collision.mjs 8/8 passes on this tree including 'flying into the tallest tower stops outside it, not inside' (approached from 140 m at alt 40 m, ended 12 m away). That gate covers the HORIZONTAL approach, which brakes. R6 is the VERTICAL ascent beside a building, which lifts.
R6_the_amplifier_is_not_the_gesture._for_the_recording: ascending from street level within ~6 m of a tall building jumps to roof + 4 m instead of climbing smoothly. Ascend from open ground, or from above 12 m, and it does not happen.
